name: transcription-agent-cli
description: Local MCP transcription tools for Claude Code and Cowork, building the engine on first use so no separate installer is needed.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key (optional)
gemini_api_key.description: For gemini-3.5-transcribe. Leave empty to use your exported key or transcriber-cli auth configuration. Applies to MCP tools.

meta_api_key.title: Meta API key (optional)
meta_api_key.description: For muse-voice-transcribe-1.0. Leave empty to use your exported key or transcriber-cli auth configuration. Applies to MCP tools.

azure_speech_key.title: Azure Speech key (optional)
azure_speech_key.description: For MAI-Transcribe-2; also set the endpoint. Leave empty to use your exported key or transcriber-cli auth configuration. Applies to MCP tools.

azure_speech_endpoint.title: Azure Speech endpoint (optional)
azure_speech_endpoint.description: Your resource origin, for example https://your-resource.cognitiveservices.azure.com. Leave empty to keep existing configuration. Applies to MCP tools.
